ds.t: So says the wise sadhu: Pramukh Swami Maharaj on good reading
w: Pramukh Swami Maharaj said, "We find time to read the world's books, but we have no rule of reading our Vachanamrut. There should be a daily rule. The Vachanamrut and the Swamini Vato are our life. Other books are fine. We may read them for knowledge, and even if we do not read them, there is not much need for them. We go to read everything else, but we have no interest in our own books. We do not understand the glory of our own books. Like the Shikshapatri, read the Vachanamrut every day. Repeat it. From it alone you will get strength and nourishment. Nourishment will come only from singing the life stories of one's own chosen deity. What life stories there are of Yogiji Maharaj, Shastriji Maharaj, Bhagatji Maharaj, Gunatitanand Swami and Shriji Maharaj! We have so much to read. Where is there time to be idle!"

At 11.45 am, Swamishri departed from Muscat and arrived in Mumbai at 3.30 pm (IST).

Every year the BAPS organizes a sponsored walk. This year 2,560 devotees between the ages of 4 to 94 took part in the 10km walk. They had contacted 47,000 sponsorers. The Mayor of Brent, Peter Layman, honored Swamishri and addressed the assembly. Finally Swamishri blessed the participants.
ph: Swamishri joyfully bowing to the devotees as they file past to begin the Walk

w: Warm Spring sunshine bathed the courtyard of the Mandir as the over 2,500 participants of the Annual Sponsored Walk gathered before Swamishri, absorbing his blessings and words of encouragement. Having contacted over 47,000 sponsors, 2,560 registered walkers spanning the ages of between 4 to 94 contributed towards a record-breaking year in the presence of Swamishri, flooding Harrow Road in a sea of blue shirts. Swamishri graced the route with his divine presence, offering darshan from his car. Ecstatic kishores performed dandvats on the pavements as a token of their devotion. The sadhus offered their support as they embarked on the demanding journey, accompanied by balaks, kishores and yuvaks. Groups of devotees, chanting the Swaminarayan mantra walked with pride and motivation, spreading bliss to the entire community. The evening assembly illustrated a montage of record-breaking achievements. Swamishri touched on the great service performed by young and old alike.
Swamishri performed the murti-pratishtha rituals of pujan and arti of murtis for BAPS hari mandirs in the Mumbai suburbs of Ghatkopar and Bhayandar.

At 11.40 a.m. Swamishri blessed him and praised him for his devotion to and faith in God and his parents. Swamishri also remembered his late father, Shri Dhirubhai Ambani, and how he was blessed by Yogiji Maharaj.

The evening Sunday assembly was held to welcome Swamishri and to appreciate the devotees who had observed various austerities and offered devotion to Thakorji. Thousands of devotees did mala, pradakshina, dandvat, chanted the Janmangal Namavali, read the Vachanamrut and Swamini Vato, sang dhun and visited the mandir for Thakorji’s darshan. They had observed austerities and performed devotion to celebrate Swamishri’s 88th birthday in December 2008. During the assembly BAPS children performed an exciting traditional welcome dance. Then some inspiring incidents of the sacrifice of devotees were briefly narrated. Thereafter a short video was shown about the devotees’ devotion and services to Harikrishna Maharaj.

Swamishri was garlanded by senior sadhus. Finally, Swamishri blessed the assembly, “It was heartening and joyful to see the service, sacrifice and devotion of the devotees of Mumbai. I congratulate you all for your sacrifice which resonates with the words of Shriji Maharaj in Vachanamrut Loya 3. Because of your devotion you invited Thakorji to sanctify your homes, and that too with great festivity. The children performed a welcome dance with intense joy and enthusiasm. All were ecstatic. Such ecstasy is possible when one has realized the glory of God. For the last one year everyone has offered devotion and seva beyond their capacities. This is possible when one has heartfelt love and devotion.” Swamishri also elaborated upon Dada Khachar’s devotion to Shriji Maharaj and how Shastriji Maharaj and Yogiji Maharaj celebrated festivals. Then he blessed all to further understand the glory of all and cultivate samp, suhrudaybhav and ekta. The assembly concluded at 8.10 p.m.

Pramukh Swami Maharaj blessed Nirnay Kapoor, the chief officer of India TV in Gujarat. Speaking about Rajat Sharma, the owner of India TV, he said, "After seeing Akshardham in Delhi he has been so overwhelmed that he says he has never seen such an organisation until today."

Speaking of his own experience, he said, "I have seen the work of the organisation. The work done with a spirit of love and service to others is wonderful. I have a question. I want to know, do you have any wish?"

Swamishri said, "I have only one wish: that religious feeling grows in everyone, that everyone becomes happy, rises above addictions and vices, and that the whole of society lives peacefully in harmony."

Speaking of his own experience, he said, "I have seen the work of the organisation. The work done in a spirit of love and service to others is wonderful. I have one question; I want to know, do you have any wish?"

Swamishri said, "I have only one wish: that religious feeling grows in everyone, that everyone becomes happy, becomes free of addictions and vices, and that the whole of society lives in peace, in harmony with one another."

On waking, Mahant Swami Maharaj sat to give personal meetings. First came Dr Debashish Bhattacharya. He has 12 large hospitals in West Bengal and treats 5,000 patients a day. The sadhus said, "He is very honest." Folding his hands humbly before Swamishri, Debashishji asked, "I want your blessings so that I can serve everyone."
Having received Swamishri's blessings, he came out and, describing his experience, said, "He is spiritually very high."
This was one more example of what a wonderful influence even a 2 or 3 minute meeting with Swamishri spreads.

st.t: Armenian Minister of Foreign Affairs Expresses ‘Shanti’ on First Visit to India and Swaminarayan Akshardham
w: Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Armenia H.E. Ararat Mirzoyan and Deputy Foreign Minister Mnatsakan Safaryan visit Swaminarayan Akshardham in New Delhi on 25 April 2022. Armenian Foreign Minister H.E. Ararat Mirzoyan traditionally welcomed by Gnanmunidas Swami. Armenian Deputy Foreign Minister Mnatsakan Safaryan traditionally welcomed by Gnanmunidas Swami. Armenian Foreign Minister H.E. Ararat Mirzoyan offering abhishek for world peace. remembrance of the Armenian Genocide Memorial Day Armenian delegation at Swaminarayan Akshardham in New Delhi on 25 April 2022. Armenian delegation at Swaminarayan Akshardham in New Delhi on 25 April 2022. On behalf of the people of Armenia, Foreign Minister H.E. Ararat Mirzoyan accepts a gift memento of Swaminarayan Akshardham and the centenary birth anniversary celebrations of Pramukh Swami Maharaj.
Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Armenia, H.E. Ararat Mirzoyan, visited Swaminarayan Akshardham in New Delhi as part of his first official trip to India.

Armenian Foreign Minister Ararat Mirzoyan and Deputy Foreign Minister Mnatsakan Safaryan, along with a 20-member Armenian delegation were greeted and traditionally welcomed by Gnanmunidas Swami on behalf of His Holiness Mahant Swami Maharaj.
Foreign Minister Mirzoyan and the delegation offered respects at the Swaminarayan Akshardham Mandir and performed abhishek for world peace and in remembrance of the Armenian Genocide Memorial Day.

After viewing Gajendra Peeth – the gallery of carved stone elephants depicting messages of peace, spirituality, family values, and social harmony, the delegation experienced the Sanskruti Vihar boat ride exhibition that displays 10,000 years of India’s heritage and discoveries.
Before he departed, Foreign Minister H.E. Ararat Mirzoyan was presented mementoes commemorating Swaminarayan Akshardham and the birth centenary celebrations of Pramukh Swami Maharaj.
Expressing his gratitude and sentiments, the Foreign Minister of Armenia Ararat Mirzoyan wrote, “It was a real honor and great pleasure for me to visit the temple. Shanti!”
